items.title: Brayden McNabb suspended three games for cross-checking
items.headline: Brayden McNabb suspended three games for cross-checking
items.summary: Vegas Golden Knights defenseman Brayden McNabb has been suspended for three preseason and regular-season games for cross-checking Los Angeles Kings forward Quinton Byfield, the NHL Department of Player Safety announced today.

items.title: Andrew Cristall fined for cross-checking
items.headline: Andrew Cristall fined for cross-checking
items.summary: Washington Capitals forward Andrew Cristall has been fined $2,000, the maximum allowable under the Collective Bargaining Agreement, for cross-checking.
